subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: What visibility should the non-tool skill-command prompt-rewrite path provide to operators?
rationale: The remaining implementation is mechanically small, but choosing between normal command output, warning logs, and debug telemetry affects user-facing noise and the permanent observability contract.

options.title: Structured debug event
options.body: Emit a structured debug or trace event identifying the skill and model-routed execution path without changing normal command replies.

options.title: Warning log
options.body: Emit a normal warning for every model-routed skill invocation, accepting potentially repetitive operator log noise.

options.title: User-visible notice
options.body: Include a concise notice in command output so end users can see that execution was delegated through the model.

recommendation.title: Structured debug event
recommendation.body: Emit a structured debug or trace event identifying the skill and model-routed execution path without changing normal command replies.

likelyOwner.reason: They previously reviewed this exact visibility boundary and have history across the adjacent command and status surfaces.
